title: AC1024 mechanical DWG strict-read opaque callback census

scope.operation: Strict dwg2dxf read and export preflight with debug tracing.
scope.purpose: Identify the source identities and record/type profiles behind the opaque callback count that blocks strict complete export. This census does not establish output coverage for any callback.

temporaryTrace.instrumentation: Temporary stderr census in dx_iface::addUnsupportedObject; removed after collection.

readDisposition.strictGate: strictDwgReadOutcomeIsComplete rejects when opaqueViewCallbacks > opaqueFramesRetainedByAdapter; the observed comparison is 228 > 0.
readDisposition.result: Strict complete export refused before the output serializer ran. The 32 standard object frames are retained for source correlation and do not establish output preservation.

evidence.identityJoin: The full callback log records handle, source offset, object type, entity/custom/class-definition flags, standard-object classification, record name and class name for every one of the 228 unique identities. The class-count projection above sums to 228.

limitations: Typed-plus-opaque callback presence does not prove complete typed field capture or DXF emission.
The callback log is outside the repository and is content-addressed above; no investigation DWG or generated DWG/DXF fixture was added.
This census does not qualify graph closure, output bytes, fresh readback, atomic publication, consumer semantics, or support claims.

planImpact.completedActionRemoved: Census the 228 opaque callback identities for the mechanical AC1024 witness and group them by object type/class/record.
planImpact.remainingP4Scope: Join the census families to existing complete source-to-output receipts; select the highest-incidence required family without full field/output proof, then qualify physical output and readback.
